def get(fr):
    wall=None; B1=None; B2=None
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]

            if bb[1]<30: B1=bb

    return wall,B1,B2
print("before:", get(current_frame))

print("after:", get(current_frame), "level", current_frame.level)
